meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用CDP协议控制Chrome浏览器，自动化执行页面操作与令牌提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要脚本化操作Chrome浏览器并复用已有登录态
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to automate browsing and extract auth tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script Chrome interactions while reusing existing login sessions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能通过CDP控制Chrome，复用登录态，执行打开网页、等待加载、运行JavaScript、截图、提取登录令牌等操作。启动调试浏览器前会先探测状态并询问你是否同意。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器操作”、“CDP”、“复用登录态”等，或要求用Chrome执行自动化时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开这个网址并提取里面的登录token
say.note: 会先探测Chrome，再打开页面并提取。

say.text: 用CDP控制浏览器，点击登录按钮
say.note: 会启动调试Chrome并执行点击。

say.text: 看看当前浏览器登录里有没有token

howto.what_en: Claude can control Chrome via CDP, reuse login sessions, open URLs, wait, run JS, snapshot, and extract auth tokens. It checks Chrome status and asks consent before launching.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "browser operation", "CDP", "reuse login" or ask for Chrome automation.

say_en.text: Open this URL and extract the login token from it.
say_en.note: Probes Chrome, opens page, then extracts.

say_en.text: Use CDP to control the browser and click the login button.
say_en.note: Launches debug Chrome and performs click.

say_en.text: Check if there is a token in the current browser login.
say_en.note: Runs JS to read localStorage or cookie.
